# TASC Architectural Decision Records

<!-- Generated by tools/tasc_index/readmes.py from index/adr-index.json. Do not edit by hand: change the source document and the workflow will regenerate this. -->

Architectural Decision Records (ADRs) capture what TASC decided, why, and the consequences. ADRs still in `Draft` live in [drafts](../drafts/). To propose an ADR, start from [template.md](template.md).

| ADR | Date | Status | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [TASC-ADR-001 Use Crossref for DOI](TASC-ADR-001%20Use%20Crossref%20for%20DOI.md) | 2026-03-23 | Proposed | GA4GH registers all of its DOIs through Crossref, using the GA4GH DOI prefix. |
| [TASC-ADR-002 Separate Citation and Standard Identifiers](TASC-ADR-002%20Separate%20Citation%20and%20Standard%20Identifiers.md) | 2026-03-23 | Proposed | DOIs are used for citing documents only; machine-readable standard identifiers are governed separately. |
| [TASC-ADR-003 Use Opaque DOI Suffixes](TASC-ADR-003%20Use%20Opaque%20DOI%20Suffixes.md) | 2026-03-23 | Proposed | GA4GH DOI suffixes are opaque and must not encode work stream, product, specification or version information. |
| [TASC-ADR-004 Use Standard Designators for DOI Metadata](TASC-ADR-004%20Use%20Standard%20Designators%20for%20DOI%20Metadata.md) | 2026-03-23 | Proposed | Every GA4GH DOI registration must carry a std_designator metadata value naming the originating group and document. |
| [TASC-ADR-005 No DOIs for Other Research Resources](TASC-ADR-005%20No%20DOIs%20for%20Other%20Research%20Resources.md) | 2026-07-07 | Proposed | GA4GH DOIs are limited to documentary outputs and are not extended to datasets, tools or other research resources. |
| [TASC-ADR-006 Require a Conformant GitHub Repository](../drafts/TASC-ADR-006%20Require%20a%20Conformant%20GitHub%20Repository.md) | 2026-08-14 | Draft | Every GA4GH technical product must have at least one GitHub repository that conforms to the TASC repository template. |
| [TASC-ADR-007 Serve Websites from ga4gh](../drafts/TASC-ADR-007%20Serve%20Websites%20from%20ga4gh.md) | 2026-08-14 | Draft | GA4GH product and topic websites must be served from a ga4gh.org subdomain; standalone or third-party domains are not permitted. |
| [TASC-ADR-008 Require a Starter Kit](../drafts/TASC-ADR-008%20Require%20a%20Starter%20Kit.md) | 2026-08-14 | Draft | Every GA4GH technical product must provide a Starter Kit giving users minimal scaffolding to build their own implementation. |
| [TASC-ADR-009 Require a Conformance Suite](../drafts/TASC-ADR-009%20Require%20a%20Conformance%20Suite.md) | 2026-08-14 | Draft | Every GA4GH technical product must have a conformance suite of tests derived from its specification. |
| [TASC-ADR-010 Adopt Technical Product Requirements](../drafts/TASC-ADR-010%20Adopt%20Technical%20Product%20Requirements.md) | 2026-08-14 | Draft | Adopts four mandatory PDAP approval requirements for technical products: GitHub repository, website, Starter Kit and conformance suite. |
| [TASC-ADR-011 Adopt the Interoperability Framework](../drafts/TASC-ADR-011%20Adopt%20the%20Interoperability%20Framework.md) | 2026-08-14 | Draft | Adopts the GA4GH 2026 TASC Interoperability framework as the basis for assessing interoperability across technical products. |
| [TASC-ADR-012 TASC Role in PDAP Governance](../drafts/TASC-ADR-012%20TASC%20Role%20in%20PDAP%20Governance.md) | 2026-08-14 | Draft | Defines TASC's role in PDAP: technical-alignment review, interoperability risk-tiering and resolving cross-product conflicts. |
